title: Billing and balance
content:
# Billing and balance

New accounts pay pay-per-use from a prepaid balance and everything else on a monthly bill. How adding funds, auto top-up, receipts and the $0 refusal work.

New accounts pay pay-per-use from a prepaid balance, and connected accounts, messages and ads on a monthly bill. Accounts created earlier pay everything on the monthly invoice, see [how billing works](/pricing/billing).

## Which accounts use the balance

New signups are on the balance. An account that signed up earlier keeps paying pay-per-use on its monthly invoice, and its Billing page stays as it was.

To check from the API:

- `GET /v1/balance` ([Get balance](/treasury/get-balance)) returns `balanceBilling: true` for an account on the balance. The field is absent otherwise.
- `GET /v1/balance/auto-recharge` answers `409` with code `balance_billing_required` for an account that is not on it.

## What each one pays for

| Paid by | What | When |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly bill | Connected accounts, inbox messages, [automation runs](/pricing/automations), managed ads and ad automations | Charged to your card on the 1st for last month, or earlier when the bill reaches a threshold (starting at $10) |
| Balance | Phone numbers, calls, SMS and 10DLC fees, RCS, iMessage senders, X API, WhatsApp calls, branded calling, Verify, SIP trunks and support assistant runs | Taken from the balance as you use them |
| Your card, per batch | Creator payouts and their fee | When you pay creators. Payouts are never paid from the balance, see [creator payouts](/pricing/creator-payouts) |

The rates are the same either way. Only where the money comes from changes.

## Adding funds

Add funds in Billing, or with `POST /v1/balance/top-ups` ([Add funds](/treasury/create-topup)) on a saved card.

- **No card fee.** Adding $100 credits $100.00 to the balance.
- **$5 minimum,** $100,000 maximum per payment. When you buy something in the dashboard and your balance is short, the minimum is what the item needs beyond your balance, never under $5: $5 for a $3 number, $10 for a $10 item. Paying the minimum can leave your balance at $0.
- **VAT on top where it applies:** 21% in Spain, your country's rate for EU consumers, none for an EU business whose VAT id VIES confirms (reverse charge) and none outside the EU. The Add funds drawer and `POST /v1/balance/top-ups/preview` show it before you pay.
- **Invoice and receipt.** Each payment has an invoice, and Stripe emails a receipt for the charge. Both are in Billing under Card payments.
- **No expiry, no refund.** The balance never expires and is not refundable. Usage paid from it carries no further VAT.

## Auto top-up

Auto top-up refills the balance from your default card: below one amount, the card is charged back up to another. Both are at least $5. A new account starts at below $5, back to $20.

- **Optional, your choice.** You choose it when you add your card or at your first purchase. It starts ticked for businesses (a VAT or tax id, or a billing address outside the EU) and unticked for EU consumers. Adding a card later shows your current choice, unchanged unless you change it.
- **Changeable any time** in Billing, or with `PATCH /v1/balance/auto-recharge` ([Update auto top-up settings](/treasury/update-auto-recharge)).
- **Monthly limit.** Optional. Once this month's auto top-ups would pass it, the card is not charged and you get one email. Turning auto top-up on when you add a card or at your first purchase sets no limit; set one in Billing.
- **Declines.** A declined charge is retried 1 hour, 1 day and 3 days later, with an email each time, then auto top-up switches off until you update the card. A decline while you are making a request switches it off at once.
- **Emails.** Stripe emails a receipt for every charge. Apart from decline, limit, low-balance and pause emails, Zernio emails you about added funds once, after your first auto top-up.

## At $0

The balance does not go below $0. New pay-per-use is refused with `402` and code `insufficient_balance`, or `usage_limit_reached` when the monthly limit kept it there.

For requests you make in the dashboard or API, with auto top-up on and a saved card, the charge runs first and the request goes through when it lands.

Scheduled and background work never charges the card at $0.

```json
{
  "error": "Your balance is at $0, so SMS is paused. Add funds in Billing to continue.",
  "type": "invalid_request_error",
  "code": "insufficient_balance",
  "funding_url": "https://zernio.com/dashboard/billing?funding=1"
}
```

Send the user to `funding_url`, which opens the Add funds drawer in Billing (the add-card drawer first when there is no card), then retry.

## How it behaves

- Inbound traffic and calls already connected are never refused at $0.
- Calls are capped by what the balance, plus what auto top-up can still add this month, pays for at their per-minute price. An outbound call it cannot fund for one minute is refused with `402`. Inbound calls always get at least 10 minutes.
- Usage already in flight when the balance ran out can land just past $0. The next funds you add cover it.
- Background work at $0 pauses until the balance is above $0, and the billing owner gets one email per pause.
- Connecting X is free. Every X API call (importing posts, syncing stats, publishing, DMs) is paid from the balance, so with no funds the import and syncs wait, and the dashboard asks you to add funds at your first X post or DM.
- Scheduled X posts at $0 wait up to 24 hours for funds, then fail with one email.
- SIP trunk calls do not ask the balance per call. Within about 5 minutes of the balance reaching $0 (when auto top-up cannot refill it), outbound calls on your trunks are blocked, with one email. Inbound keeps ringing. Outbound returns within about 5 minutes of adding funds.
- Phone numbers are charged when activated and renewed on the 1st. A number left unpaid at $0 keeps working, is held for 14 days with reminder emails, then released.
- Orders billed later need their fees in the balance, unless auto top-up can refill it: a number's first month, an RCS agent's fees up to launch, an iMessage sender's or caller identity's first month, 10DLC fees. Orders awaiting approval keep theirs set aside until billed or rejected.
- A 10DLC campaign whose monthly fee is left unpaid at $0 stays registered but cannot send. After 14 days with reminder emails it is deactivated, which cannot be undone; its numbers stay and keep receiving, and you can register a new campaign later.
- An RCS agent whose monthly fee is left unpaid at $0 stays registered but cannot send until the balance is back above $0. After 14 days with reminder emails it is suspended: its monthly fee stops until you add funds, and the next month bills again.
- [Billing webhooks](/webhooks/billing) fire `balance.low`, `balance.empty` and `balance.charged`.

## If it fails

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `402 insufficient_balance` | The balance is at $0 and no auto top-up lifted it, or it cannot hold an order's later fees (`required_cents`) | Add funds at `funding_url`, then retry |
| `402 usage_limit_reached` | The auto top-up monthly limit stopped the charge | Raise `monthlyLimitCents`, or add funds by hand |
| `402 payment_required` when adding funds | No saved card | Add a card in Billing |
| `402 card_declined` when adding funds | The bank refused the charge | Use another card |
| `409 balance_billing_required` | The account is not on the balance | Nothing to set: its pay-per-use is on the monthly invoice |
